name: Taskline
tagline: Capture work fast, stay organized, finish cleanly.
positioning: Taskline is a clean, fast todo app for busy individuals and small teams who want to capture tasks instantly, organize them into simple lists, and move work to done without clutter. It combines natural-language task entry, drag-and-drop prioritization, recurring tasks, reminders, search and filters, and lightweight shared-list collaboration so users can stay focused on execution instead of administration.

routes.purpose: Public landing page with product value proposition and call to action
Authenticated shell with dashboard summary and navigation
Quick capture inbox and uncategorized tasks
Single list/project board with task ordering
Task detail panel with notes, comments, reminders, and recurrence
Search and filter view across tasks
Reminder management and upcoming due work
Create, update, reorder, complete, and delete tasks
Invite collaborators and accept shared-list access

workflows.name: Quick-add a task in the inbox using natural language like 'Send proposal tomorrow 3pm p1' and have it parsed into title, due date, and priority.
Move a task from Inbox into a list/project and reorder it with drag-and-drop.
Open a task detail panel to edit notes, add labels, set recurrence, and schedule reminders.
Share a list with a teammate by email invite and collaborate through comments on tasks in that list.
Search and filter tasks by due date, label, status, priority, and list.

primaryWorkflow: Quick-add a task in the inbox with a natural-language due date, then organize it into a list/project and see it persist in the ordered task view.
acceptanceChecks: A signed-in user can create a task from the Inbox using a natural-language due date and see the parsed task appear in the list immediately.
Dragging a task to a different list updates its list assignment and order without a full page reload.
Opening a task detail panel lets the user edit notes, priority, labels, recurrence, and reminders, and those changes persist after refresh.
A user can add a comment to a task and the comment appears in the task thread for subsequent visits.
A list can be shared by email invite, and an invited collaborator can access the shared list after accepting the invite.
Search and filters return only tasks that match the selected due date, label, status, or priority criteria.
